name: FilterGS
aliases: Parallel filtering structure for Gaussian scale selection
definition: FilterGS is a rendering acceleration method for large-scale Level-of-Detail (LoD) 3D Gaussian Splatting that eliminates inefficient serial tree traversal and reduces redundant Gaussian-tile pairs through parallel filtering and adaptive shrinking.
summary: FilterGS is a traversal-free parallel filtering method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that eliminates serial tree traversal by using parallel steps and adaptive shrinking to accelerate rendering.
